name: Eyecon

search.notes: Lookups only work inside the mobile app, so the agent cannot check whether the number is listed.

steps: Draft an erasure request that names the phone number with country code and asks Eyecon to remove the name and photo shown for it.
Send it to privacy@instabridge.com, with support@eyecon-app.com in copy.
Answer any identity check from the same email address.
Record the date sent and follow up after 30 days.
optout.notes: No public unlist page was found on 2026-10-27. Eyecon is run by Instabridge Sweden AB, and the privacy policy lists privacy@instabridge.com and support@eyecon-app.com as contacts. A GDPR erasure letter fits since the controller is in Sweden.

verification_note: Privacy policy text read through the site's own WordPress API on 2026-10-27. The guessed URL eyecon-app.com/unlist did not respond.
